assumptions.preparation: Ownership, Lv60/legal ascension, talent6, C0, ordinary crafted weapons/reinforced leather/healing brooch +6, funding1000000 and region/story access granted. No artifacts/exclusive/boss gear/food. The brooch is Sumeru-crafted; this is a Lv60 prepared-account sample, not a pre-Sumeru beginner access proof.
assumptions.start: At the current native blossom map; initial trip to the blossom and acquisition/strengthening time excluded. One initial full heal. No combat HP reset.
assumptions.actions: Native public PLACE_ENTER -> BOSS_ROUTE tier5 -> COMBAT_BEGIN/COMBAT and actual balanced companion AI. Traveler Q, hold E, basic. Native MOVE return encounters and actually quoted/paid inn recovery until the same full-HP inn endpoint.
assumptions.clock: Native current action clock/hour, not elapsed-model clock. Claim remains once per real hour per kind across regions. No clock jump, quota reset, enemy kill, hit/RNG override.
assumptions.time: Displayed 2x model from H.observe/H.recover: presentation ms/1000 +3s per combat input +6s receipt/reentry +4s entry +4s per move +10s inn transaction, defeat penalty where native. Initial trip, network/human hesitation, acquisition and wait for hourly claim excluded.
assumptions.reward: Tier5 WEALTH 40000 Mora; REVELATION180 hero books=180000 XP to distribute account-wide, direct400 XP per participating actor; EXP domain comparison is per-actor reward. Travel encounter reward is separately counted.
